model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the closing price of Chainlink (LINK) for August 6, 2026, as reported in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Chainlink Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/chainlink/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-06 (UTC daily close). Bands are inclusive of the lower bound and exclusive of the upper bound; for example, a close of exactly $8.15 resolves to the $8.15–$8.30 band.
